Paragraph: On 5 February 2026 a patient at the Mumbai branch complained that the CBC report was delayed by two days. The front desk apologised and the report was emailed late in the evening. The patient asked for faster turnaround for routine tests.

On 14 March 2026 the Pune branch received praise for a painless blood draw during a lipid profile test. The phlebotomist found the vein on the first attempt and the patient said the fasting instructions were clear.

At the Nagpur centre on 22 April 2026 a patient waited ninety minutes in a crowded queue for an HbA1c test. Several patients left without testing and asked for an online booking system with fixed time slots.

A thyroid profile in Thane on 9 May 2026 was billed with hidden charges that were not shown on the package page. The billing team corrected the invoice after a complaint and promised transparent pricing.
On 30 May 2026 a home collection pickup in Nashik for a Vitamin D test was cancelled without notice. The patient waited at home for three hours and then booked another slot through the mobile app.
In Navi Mumbai on 18 June 2026 a liver function report showed a wrong patient name and an incorrect value. A retest was arranged free of cost and the quality team started an error review.

On 11 July 2026 the Mumbai branch collection room was praised for hygiene, with sterile equipment and fresh gloves. Patients doing kidney function tests described the nurse as caring and professional.

A patient in Pune on 25 July 2026 found the fasting instructions confusing and arrived after eating breakfast. The fasting blood sugar test had to be rescheduled and the lab agreed to send clearer preparation guidance.

On 3 August 2026 the online portal of the Thane branch crashed repeatedly while patients tried to download CBC reports. Support staff emailed the reports manually and the technical team investigated the website login problem.

The Nagpur centre on 19 August 2026 delivered lipid profile results within four hours, which patients called fast and reliable. The receptionist guided elderly patients politely and the waiting time stayed short.

On 2 September 2026 a patient in Nashik reported a painful needle prick and a large bruise after an HbA1c draw. The technician had made multiple attempts and the branch manager offered a follow up with an experienced phlebotomist.

In Navi Mumbai on 16 September 2026 the thyroid profile package was described as affordable and good value. Patients liked the transparent billing and the reminder messages about fasting and report collection.
